B1ock:834 Lots: 66& 69 36-46 W. 33rd’ St., NY, NY AMENDMENTOFZONINGLOTAND DEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT day of November, 2014, by and between 38-46 WEST 33 STREET LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address at c/o The Torkian Group, 1650 Broadway, New York, New York 10019 ("Developer"), and SHEA REALTY, INC., a New York corporation having an address at c/o Allied Management, Ltd., 232 West 48th Street, New York, New York 10036 ("Seller"). Recitals WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain real property located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, which property is designated as Block 834, Lot 69 on the Tax Map of the City of New York for the Borough of Manhattan and known by the street address 38-46 West 33rd Street, New York, New York, and is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (*"Developer's Land"); ：WHEREAS, Seller is the owner of certain real property located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, which property is'designated as Block 834, Lot 66 on the Tax Map of the City of New York for the Borough of Manhattan and known by the street address 36 West 33rd Street, New York, New York, and is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto ("Seller's Land"); WHEREAS, Seller's Land is improved with Seller's Existing Building, (as defined in the ZLDA), a 4-story building that is currently used for a restaurant and bar and residential use; WHEREAS, Seller intends to alter Seller's Existing Building for entirely commercial use that will include an outdoor bar and restaurant on the rooftop; WHEREAS, Developer and Seller have executed that certain Zoning Lot and Development Agreement, dated as of November 1, 2007, which Zoning and Lot Development Agreement was recorded on November 14, 2007 in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York as CRFN 2007000568831 (the “ZLDA"); . WHEREAS,Developer and Sellerwish to amend the ZLDA toprovide that theExcess Development Rights transferred thereunder include all Bonus Floor Area Development Rights (as defined herein) available to Seller's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; to provide for certain construction licenses; and to provide for easements that allow a portion of the Developer's Proposed Building to encroach over and remain located over and above a portion of the Seller's Land; WHEREAS, Commonwealth Land Title Insurance Comipany has certified in a certificate annexed hereto as Exhibit C that as of the date set forth above, Developer,Seller, Manufacturers Traders and Trust Company, Country Bank and Hersel Torkian and Behrooz Torkian are the F:ASMTORKIANAMENDMENT OFZONINGLOT(66).doc

only parties-in-interest (as that term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York) with respect to the Developer's Land and the Seller's Land; and Torkian and Behrooz Torkian have executed instruments consenting to this Amendment, copies of which instruments are annexed hereto asExhibit D; NOW, THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the sufficiency and receipt of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto covenant and agree on behalf of themselves and their successors-in-interest and assigns as follows: 1. All capitalized terms not otherwise defined herein shall have the meanings ascribedtothemintheZLDA. 2. The term“Floor Area Development Rights” set forth in Section E of the Recitals to the ZLDA is hereby deleted and replaced as follows: The rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop the zoning lot by erecting or adding thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by multiplying thearea of thezoninglotby theFloorAreaRatioestablishedfor thezoning district or districts in which the zoning lot is located and the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution andwhichmaybe authorized tobedevelopedby theappropriate agency of the City of New York from time to time. 3. The term“Excess Development Rights” set forth in Section F of the Recitals to the ZLDA is hereby deleted and replaced as follows: All Floor Area Development Rights that were appurtenant to the Seller's Land in excess of Floor AreaDevelopmentRightsutilizedby theimprovementslocated on Seller's Land as of November 1, 2007 which excess is 11,823.12 square feet, and the right to include the lot area of Seller's Land in the calculation of Bonus Floor Area Development Rights. 4. A new term“Bonus Floor Area Development Rights”is hereby added as Section K of the Recitals to the ZLDA,as follows: constructed on a zoning lot either (i) through the provision of a bonusable amenity or public benefit,either on or off the Combined Zoning Lot in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Zoning Resolution, or (i) on an as-of-right basis or by special permit, authorization, certification, variance or by any other procedure or transfer allowed under the provisions of the Zoning Resolution, including without limitation, Sections 34-223,35-35,74-79 et seq.and 23-90, respectively.
